poc-0014 2026-09-09
SHIFT NOTES — Hydraulics Owner Contacts for the
Evening Shift
Date: 2026-09-09
Station: DEMO-STATION-01
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
15:50 — PERSON-0013 takes the evening coordination desk for
TEAM-0001. Prepare the owner-contact sheet used for
blocked-item follow-up. ISSUE-0018 is the hydraulics locating
reference for this sheet; its presence here does not label the
record.
46:25 — Call the owning-team lead for each dependency selected
for the evening round. Ask for the responsible desk, the
answer being sought, and the next contact time. Keep task
assignment questions separate from who will make the next
coordination call.
17:20 — Use TASK-0046, TASK-0047, and TASK-0048 in their
respective reference spaces when discussing the hydraulics
papers. Record the role that promised to obtain an answer. The
person taking the call should not become the task's assignee
by default.
18:10 — Take unanswered owner questions to the duty chair
using question-first escalation. Write the missing answer
first, then the role seeking it and the next contact time. The
chair needs a specific ownership choice, not a request to make
the queue move faster.
Next-shift list
— Retain the original owner-contact sheet beside the evening
call notes.
— Carry each unanswered dependency with its promised contact
time.
D. Worker 0013
Demo Worker 0013, Demo Team 01
